architectures.name: A
architectures.rationale: Five-node path: a sparse, connected baseline with no native four-qubit cycle. Both CX directions are supported.

architectures.name: A_cycle
architectures.rationale: Four-cycle plus tail isolates connectivity from qubit budget.

architectures.name: B
architectures.rationale: Participant-designed 3x3 square lattice, 12 edges. Native four-cycles support ring interactions. This is a synthetic architecture, not a claim to reproduce IBM heavy-hex hardware. Both CX directions are supported.

architectures.name: B_reference
architectures.rationale: Guide reference B graph; matched synthetic channels.

architectures.name: B_tree
architectures.rationale: Nine-node tree tests whether extra qubits alone reduce routing.

displayPrecision: Kernel matrices and point coordinates rounded to seven decimal places; full precision in source NPZ files.
